title: The for Loop
instructions: A loop repeats code so you don't copy-paste it. The for loop is the most common.
It has three parts inside its parentheses, separated by semicolons:
for (start ; keep going while this is true ; step)
Example: for (int i = 1; i <= 5; i++) starts i at 1, runs while i is 5 or less, and adds 1 to i each time.
So the body runs 5 times, with i being 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.
task: Fill in the loop condition so it counts 1 through 5, printing each number.
